title: 虚假评论检测综述：从预训练语言模型到大语言模型
summary: 本文从信息融合视角综述了2018至2026年间211项虚假评论检测研究，涵盖文本、情感、评分行为、时序元数据、用户-商品图、多模态内容及LLM生成信号，梳理了从传统机器学习到PLM和LLM方法的演进，并分析了Amazon、Yelp、OpSpam等基准的性能趋势与评估局限。
summary_en: This survey reviews 211 fake review detection studies from 2018 to early 2026 through an information fusion lens, covering review text, sentiment, rating behavior, temporal metadata, user-product graphs, multimodal content, and LLM-generated signals. It traces the evolution from traditional ML and deep learning to PLM- and LLM-based methods, analyzes performance trends on Amazon, Yelp, and OpSpam benchmarks, and identifies open problems in adversarial generation, cross-domain transfer, uncertainty-aware fusion, and trustworthy evaluation.
